description:
Privacy-first logic puzzles. No ads, no internet, no account required.

Quiet Grid is a collection of logic puzzles for Android. No ads, no tracking, no internet connection required — everything runs entirely on your device.

Puzzles included:

  • Chimp Test — Tap the numbers in order before they disappear.
  • Takuzu — Fill a grid with 0s and 1s: each row and column must have equal counts, no three in a row, and no two rows or columns may be identical.
  • Nonogram — Deduce which cells to fill based on number clues along rows and columns.
  • Minesweeper — Classic grid puzzle. Uncover all safe cells without triggering a mine.
  • Sudoku — Place digits 1–9 so every row, column, and 3×3 box contains each digit exactly once.
  • Word Search — Find hidden words in a grid of letters.
  • Block Fill (Beta) — Drag pieces onto the grid and clear full lines.
  • Word Guess — Guess the hidden word in six tries.
  • Animal Doku — Place one animal in every row, column, and colored region, with no two animals touching, even diagonally.
  • Arrow Escape (Beta) — Clear the board, one arrow at a time.
  • 2048 — Slide and merge matching tiles until one of them reaches 2048.
  • Star Battle — Place stars in every row, column, and region with no two touching.
  • Guess by Numbers — Guess the hidden word in ten tries; two numbers show how close each guess was.
  • N-Back (Beta) — Watch the grid and tap Match whenever the lit square repeats its position from N steps back.

Each puzzle type offers Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert difficulty levels.

Privacy by design:

Quiet Grid does not use the internet, request dangerous permissions, or collect any data. All progress and settings are stored locally on your device.

Available in English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, and Polish.
